1945, October 22
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N. Y.
1945, October 22 (found Aug. 21, -- '51)
Mr. Rae Garland Detroit, Michigan
Dear Rae:
God Bless you and yours. Many thanks for favor of the 19th just noted. Am enrolling you and family and the holy suf- fering Souls for your guidance. Glad of your interesting meet. on the first. Mrs O'Malley sent me word about it yesterday.
Now I must tell you something that, in a way, I do not like to do. Its this. The arch enemy of our Blessed Mother and of im- mortal souls, at all times on the alert, must have received an ex- tra length of rope these days. I have been reported as having been phoning you longdistance and the "Agradan . Society"! ! !
Whatever the source, it seems to have given important offense, if not scandal . . Therefore, I wish that for the present and until you be better known and your efforts recognized, you leave me out of the picture. Afterall if Venerable Mary of Agrata is a saint, about which I find it personally unreasonable to doubt, then., in my way of thinking, its high time she get active in working a miracle of some kind, in clearing away the prejudice or jealousy or at least misunderstanding that has hampered her work --- which is not hers but God's work --- and hes pressed on your sholders for three years and on mine for at least seven.
Sincerely, in Christ
Fr. Sclanus, O. F. M. Cap.
IV Book ". . . not your work . . but the work of The HIGHEST TRUTH." Our M. Mother co M. M. of Agreda. About 575 Coronation about 575
